source_signals: agent-lab-package.zip: learning/ (routing, ledger, eval, runs/*/telemetry, regress), reports/ (20), agents, skills, scripts. learning/signals.json is stale (RUN-001..007 only), so most proposals cite file:line evidence instead of SIG ids.
ranking_method: rank = expected gain / effort (S=1, M=2, L=3). Gains are computed from package numbers where marked 'computed', otherwise labelled 'estimate'. Not the CAWL EV formula.
held_out_note: cm-01..03 have already been held-out cases for 3 roles / 4 bundles; prefer a fresh capability case (AL-10) where the eval_plan says so. Advice only: NEXUS tests locally and applies only on ACCEPT.

change.text: New 'regress precheck <label> --target=recall|severity': prepare+run baseline with --reps=1, grade, and refuse to prepare the candidate when target=recall and baseline recall >= 0.95*max (or target=severity and baseline agreement >= 0.9). Append {verdict:'SKIPPED_CEILING', case, baseline} to learning/ledger.jsonl so the case is flagged for AL-10 demotion.

evidence: learning/runs/CM-CORAX-V1/RESULT.md:15 (both arms at ceiling on cm-01)
CLAUDEMAXING-LOOP.md:12 ('eval cases must be below ceiling') - rule exists, no code enforces it
proposals.root_cause: Ceiling status is only discovered after both arms x 3 reps have run.
proposals.expected_effect: computed: RUN-014 (~275K) + RUN-023 (~389K) = ~664K = ~15% of ~4.42M measured gate spend; a 1-rep precheck costs ~1/6 of a 2x3 gate, saving ~83% of each doomed gate.
proposals.risk: Low. A case just under the threshold still runs; threshold is a parameter.
proposals.eval_plan: Replay: run precheck logic on the stored baseline eval files of RUN-013/014/015/023 and CM-*; it must flag RUN-014 and RUN-023 and no gate that produced ACCEPT. 0 tokens.
